description: Read the full kanban state of a 'todo' board: `{ mode, columns, tasks }`, both ordered by their `sort` key (ascending). Each task carries its hot fields (name, due_date, priority, assignee, done, column_id, sort) plus an opaque `content` JSON string (holds the description). Use this to get exact column/task ids before updating, moving or deleting.

access_key.description: 8-character lowercase alphanumeric board access key when the board is locked (legacy 6-character lowercase alphanumeric keys are also accepted). Equivalent to setting the `X-Board-Key` HTTP header on the JSON-RPC POST. Omit for unlocked boards. Obtain via POST /api/boards/<id>/lock.

name: list_tasks
title: List Tasks
